_note: Shared rule values. The web copy (lib/site.ts) and the docs build (docs/build.mjs) both read this file. Source of truth in code: clubs/src/context.ts minBuyUsd, clubs/src/streaks.ts, and the indexer real-fan line.
streakRule: One buy of $5 or more through Tropa Club in any rolling 14 days keeps your streak alive. Each calendar month has one free skip: a gap of up to 28 days survives if that month's skip is unused.
streakShort: Buy $5 or more through Tropa Club at least once every 14 days to keep your streak alive, with one free skip a calendar month (a gap of up to 28 days).
realFanLine: A real fan (real holder) holds $10 or more of the token. That is a different line from the $5 that counts as played in a gameweek.

caps.copy: Caps are a scoreboard, not a currency. They can't be bought, sold, transferred or redeemed. Caps are a scoreboard, not a promise: anything we launch later will be announced separately.

scouts.copy: No prizes, no cash, just your name on the board.

fixtureRule: Each week from Mon Nov 30, clubs of 3 or more are paired with a club of a similar size. 3 points if more of your club played than theirs: the share of members who bought $5 or more that week. If the two are within 1 percentage point, the club with more members still holding last week's buy at day 7 takes the 3 points, and if that is level too it is 1 point each. Any club where 80% or more of members bought also gets 1 bonus point. Returns decide nothing.
fixtureShort: 3 points if more of your club played than theirs.
